query: I changed POSTGRES_PASSWORD in .env and now the examples can't log in to the database. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Explains that the password is only applied when postgres-data/ is first created
Runs the ALTER USER command via psql -v pw so the password is never printed
Verifies a connection with load_settings() afterwards

query: Make a backup of the vector database before I try something risky.
expected_behavior: Uses pg_dump --format=custom inside the container and docker cp to copy it out
Sets MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 in Git Bash
Reports the backup file path and the row count of documents at backup time

query: Start over with a completely empty database.
expected_behavior: Uses docker compose down and deletes postgres-data/ (not docker compose down -v)
Confirms with the user before deleting the data folder
Restarts with docker compose up -d and checks the container is healthy

query: Add support for .html files to the ingestion.
expected_behavior: Adds the dispatch in loader.py and sets source and category metadata
Adds a unit test in tests/unit/test_ingestion.py using tmp_path
Runs ingestion twice and checks the row count does not change

query: I don't have an OpenAI key yet but want data in the vector table.
expected_behavior: Runs examples.ingest_documents --fake-embeddings
Explains that similarity search is meaningless with fake vectors but keyword search and filters work
Notes that a later run without the flag overwrites the same rows

query: After lowering CHUNK_SIZE I re-ingested, and now some answers quote old text. Why?
expected_behavior: Identifies stale rows: deterministic ids per position, fewer or more chunks leave old positions
Recommends resetting the database before re-ingesting
Does not propose adding random ids (which would break idempotency)

query: Ingest my manual.pdf and split it by chapter only, not by section.
expected_behavior: Runs examples.pdf_chunking with max_heading_level 1 first to inspect font sizes and sections
Explains detected body size and heading levels
Mentions limits if headings are bold-only or the PDF is scanned

query: Headings that are only bold are not detected. Add bold detection.
expected_behavior: Writes a failing test first in tests/unit/test_pdf_loader.py
Uses fontname to detect bold without breaking the existing edge cases
Re-runs examples.pdf_chunking on the sample PDF and explains any changed section counts

query: Write a test that generates a PDF with fpdf2.
expected_behavior: Calls multi_cell with new_x="LMARGIN" and new_y="NEXT"
Uses tmp_path for the generated PDF
Keeps pure logic tests on TextLine lists without a PDF

query: Add a reranking strategy to the retriever comparison.
expected_behavior: Creates a new module with SCORE_LABEL and one function
Labels the reranker score separately from distances
Adds unit and integration tests and updates docs/03_retrieval.md plus the German copy

query: Hybrid search returns nothing from the keyword side for 'What does TK-407 mean?'
expected_behavior: Explains that plainto_tsquery requires every word ('mean' is missing)
Suggests a keyword-like query or a different tsquery function
Keeps a fresh HybridSearchConfig per call

query: Is a similarity score of 0.4 better than an RRF score of 0.03?
expected_behavior: States the scores are not comparable
Explains distance (lower is better) vs relevance vs RRF (higher is better)
Points to the SCORE_LABEL of each strategy

query: Make the LangChain chain also return the retrieved chunk count.
expected_behavior: Keeps question, sources and answer in the output
Avoids piping two plain callables (uses a lambda inside the input dict)
Updates tests/unit/test_langchain_chain.py and runs pytest

query: Change the RAG prompt so answers are in German.
expected_behavior: Edits RAG_PROMPT in prompt.py only
Mentions that both LangGraph graphs share this prompt
Keeps the grounding rule (use only the context)

query: Test the chain without calling OpenAI.
expected_behavior: Uses RunnableLambda for the retriever
Uses GenericFakeChatModel or a recording RunnableLambda LLM
Runs uv run python -m pytest

query: Add a node to the basic LangGraph RAG that summarizes the retrieved documents before answering.
expected_behavior: Creates a separate node file with Reads/Writes docstring
Adds the state key, binds the LLM with functools.partial in graph.py
Adds a node test and a graph-order test

query: Show me how the state changes while the graph runs.
expected_behavior: Uses graph.stream(..., stream_mode="updates")
Optionally prints graph.get_graph().draw_mermaid()
Explains that nodes return only changed keys

query: My node test fails because the LLM is a MagicMock and the node uses prompt | llm.
expected_behavior: Rewrites the node to explicit PROMPT.invoke + llm.invoke(...).text calls
Keeps graph.py free of logic
Re-runs the unit tests until green

query: Add a step that checks whether the generated answer is supported by the documents and retries otherwise.
expected_behavior: LLM decision via with_structured_output stored in state; routing stays pure Python
Loop is bounded by a retry counter
Tests at routing, node and graph level

query: For questions not in the documents, the agent should never invent an answer.
expected_behavior: Uses the deterministic fallback NO_RELEVANT_DOCUMENTS_ANSWER without an LLM call
Points to route_after_grading and max_retries
Adds or runs the graph test that ends in the fallback

query: Test the agentic graph offline.
expected_behavior: Uses fake_llm (MagicMock with scripted with_structured_output) instead of GenericFakeChatModel
Asserts the exact visited node sequence
Covers the boundary retry_count == max_retries

query: Add a documentation chapter about evaluation of RAG answers.
expected_behavior: Creates docs/09_*.md and the German copy with the same file name
Adds a start page card with literal translate ids and fills i18n/de/code.json
Runs npm run build until both locales succeed

query: I fixed a typo in docs/03_retrieval.md.
expected_behavior: Checks whether the German copy needs the same fix
Rebuilds or reminds to rebuild the site
Does not copy the English file over the German one

query: npm start shows only English, the language switch doesn't work.
expected_behavior: Explains that npm start serves one locale
Suggests npm start -- --locale de, or npm run build + npm run serve for the switch
Does not change the i18n configuration

query: Which of my three RAG implementations gives the best answers?
expected_behavior: Runs examples.calibrate_judges before trusting scores
Runs examples.evaluate_rag (optionally with --limit first) and compares pass rates per judge
Reads the reasoning of failed verdicts before concluding

query: Add a judge that checks whether the answer cites its source file.
expected_behavior: Schema with explanation as first field and a bool verdict
Adds one good and one bad CalibrationCase and unit tests with a fake judge
Updates JUDGE_NAMES, run_all_judges and the docs chapter in both languages

query: The relevance judge fails the agent's answer to the dogs question. Fix the judge.
expected_behavior: Explains that a correct refusal can fail relevance while passing correctness
Does not tune one judge to match another without a calibration case
Proposes a CalibrationCase if the judge is really wrong

query: Which retrieval strategy finds the right chunk most often?
expected_behavior: Generates or reuses evaluation_data/retrieval_dataset.json and asks to review the questions
Runs examples.evaluate_retrieval and compares Hit@k and MRR per strategy
Mentions that the metadata filter is an oracle upper bound and that scores are a lower bound

query: evaluate_retrieval says labelled chunks are no longer in the database.
expected_behavior: Explains that re-ingesting with other chunking changed the chunk ids
Regenerates the dataset with examples.generate_retrieval_dataset (same seed)
Does not edit chunk ids in the JSON by hand

query: Show me in MLflow what the agentic graph does for a question.
expected_behavior: Checks the mlflow container is running and MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI matches MLFLOW_PORT
Runs examples.agentic_rag and points to the trace in experiment rag-examples
Does not import mlflow directly in the example

query: Log the PDF chunking statistics to MLflow.
expected_behavior: Uses enable_mlflow(..., tracing=False), mlflow_run and log_results from rag_lab.tracking
Keeps the example working without MLflow (use_mlflow flag)
Adds a mocked unit test and documents the experiment

query: docker compose up fails: ports are not available 5000
expected_behavior: Identifies which container or process uses the port
Moves this project's MLflow to a free port via MLFLOW_PORT and MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI
Leaves the other container untouched

query: I need Hit@k and MRR for the retriever in my other project - give me the code.
expected_behavior: Points to retrieval_metrics_template.py and its dependency header
Explains that each question needs exactly one gold chunk id
Mentions reviewing generated questions and the lower-bound caveat

query: Set up the same RAG chain in a new project.
expected_behavior: Copies rag_chain_template.py instead of importing rag_lab
Installs the packages listed in its header
Runs the offline test snippet first
